cs-alert-bot: ALERT: LumenPay account health dropped to 62% (usage 7d change: -42%). Renewal in 30 days. Auto-tagged: "low-usage".

Aisha Rivera: Heads up — saw the alert. LumenPay used to be steady at 85% last quarter, then a steep drop starting last Thursday. Renewal 4/18. Suspect product-fit friction after recent schema change.

Ben Cho: Thanks — can you paste the top two signals? is it token volume, embeddings, or new session count?

Aisha Rivera: From billing/metrics: tokens -28%, sessions -10%, active routes down -45% specifically on the `invoice-gen` model route. No errors in logs.

Priya Desai: That route hit a model upgrade last week, right? Might be perf regression causing client to throttle. Do we have rollout metadata?

Ben Cho: I pulled the rollout: `model=v2.3-quant,gpu-pool=dedicated-east` -> canary -> full on 3/27. Canary traces show 120ms latency increase at p95 for short prompts.

Aisha Rivera: Customer feedback: "responses feel slower and sometimes truncated" — from their CS inbox thread. They started toggling service down to basic embedding calls.

Nate Collins: Proposed immediate actions: 1) rollback `invoice-gen` to v2.2 for LumenPay only (canary rollback + pin), 2) schedule a 30m enablement call to re-walk prompt best practices, 3) provide a short credit + concierge assist to surface lost features.

Priya Desai: I can do the rollback. Will create a canary policy override for customer-id=lp_842 and pin model to v2.2. ETA 15m. Also will attach perf traces.

Ben Cho: I'll prepare a short diff showing perf delta + a quick repro snippet the SEs can run. Adding below:
```
# repro: short invoice prompt
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"route":"invoice-gen","prompt":"Summarize invoice items","max_tokens":120}'
```

Aisha Rivera: I'll draft an enablement invite for tomorrow PST and ping their lead. Also prepping a 1-pager explaining rollback + why it helps.

cs-alert-bot: NOTE: ticket #CS-4821 created automatically and linked to account lp_842.

Nate Collins: Quick customer messaging suggestion (short): "We've identified a performance regression after our recent model update and are rolling back the invoice route for you. We'll also set up a 30-minute walkthrough to get you back to previous throughput. — Aisha"

Priya Desai: Rollback done (config change committed). Pin set. Perf traces attached to ticket.

Ben Cho: Perf delta doc uploaded to ticket. p95 back to prior baseline.

Aisha Rivera: Great — I'm sending the message now and scheduling the 30m enablement for tomorrow 11:00am PT. I also offered a one-off credit for the renewal month.

Nate Collins: Follow-up asks: can we add a short-run monitoring rule for `route:invoice-gen` to alert at -20% route traffic or +50ms p95 so we catch regressions faster?

Ben Cho: Yep — I'll add the rule and a light dashboard widget for CSM view.

Aisha Rivera: Thanks team. I'll update the renewal risk tag to "watching" and close the immediate incident if no further drop in 24h. Will post a short recap in the renewal prep doc. :thumbsup:

Priya Desai: If anything else happens, ping me and I'll prioritize a hotfix build.

Aisha Rivera: Closing loop — customer responded: "Thanks — much better, latency fixed and flows restored. Appreciate the quick help." I'll move to nurture cadence and log the enablement notes.

cs-alert-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: CS-4821 (auto-closed after no regressions for 6h).
